name: Komachi Maya
source:
[url=/c34572]Mahiru's[/url] older sister and a waitress working at the restaurant Naturale.

Although she is nice to everyone, she is especially kind to [url=/c34578]Souta[/url]. She helps him out whenever he has problems and likes to cook for him. She is also as good a cook as Souta is, especially when it comes to sweets.
[spoiler]She has a crush on Souta and openly makes moves on him.[/spoiler]
